items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: it was a great deal of Scott Junkins' music. Yeah, they played lots of that stuff, man. I don't think I'd know it for him.

ctx.x: What tunes would they play back in those times?

Oh, man, I'll be frank with you, I had to go back some to get them together. But, uh, it was a great deal of Scott Junkins' music. Yeah, they played lots of that stuff, man. I don't think I'd know it for him. While I holler and, uh, blaming on the blues and physical defeat. Oh, man, that's a gang of stuff. Oh, good minutes. Stuff that I just don't know the name of. But that was the most of the music, though, they never played no, uh, make-up numbers, you know? Mm-hmm. That was all solid stuff. High Society,…
